Its running header reads 'D.Lgs. 30 giugno 2003, n. 196 — testo trascritto'. It is not an official Normattiva document and has not been verified against an official text.

Article status (for example repeal) is recorded only as this file prints it.

method: Text: PyMuPDF page.get_text('dict') lines of the source PDF, stripped of leading and trailing whitespace; nothing else in a line is changed.
Article heading: a line consisting only of 'Art. ' plus an identifier (a number, an optional hyphenated Latin suffix, an optional '.n' sub-number), as printed.

Division heading: a line consisting only of PARTE, TITOLO, CAPO or SEZIONE plus a roman numeral (optionally '0.'), optionally preceded by '(('. Parent paths follow the printed order (a PARTE closes the open TITOLO, CAPO and SEZIONE, and so on).

Article title: the bracketed text after the heading, up to the line where the brackets balance, joined with single spaces. A '((ARTICOLO ABROGATO ...))' text in that place is recorded as status_marker instead.
Pages: page_start is the heading's page; page_end the page of the article's last line before the next heading, the closing formula or the scope end.
